design: Frozen H283 mixtures and base. Native intact MLP output is shared oracle anchor; predict only changed output difference. Full and quarter source-head removals, plus matched norm/pre-dot angle payloads. No fit or test selection.

gates.actual_gain: mixture vs frozen base conditional KL reduction>=5% and paired95 lower>0 at both scales
gates.actual_retention: mixture vs shrunken single paired95 lower>-.03 at both scales

scope: Conditional response repair, not intact replacement. All nine heads. Bootstrap documents with all heads/positions clustered. Separate intact evidence H283.
interval_scope: 97.5% per contrast, not simultaneous familywise intervals; bootstrap conditions on frozen fits
